book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Gunda Addeza Paxo
Hessafe guye Yesusi abba bolla wogolora pinnidi kase ba diza katama yides.
Heen issi gunda addeza, asay halara
tookkidi Yesusaakko ehides. Yesusikka istta ammano be7idi gunda addeza, «Aykkoy baa; haysso naazoo! Ne nagaray atto geetettides» gides.
He wode Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti, «Hayssi Xoossa cashsha» giidi ba wozinan qoppida.
Yesusi istta qofaa eridi, «Intte wozinan iita yo7o aazas qoppeetii?
‹Ne nagaray atto geetettides› guussafenne ‹Dendada ba!› guussafe awayssi kawushshee?
Gido attiin Asa Naas biitta bolla ase nagarappe maaranaas sheney dizayssa erana malassa» giidi gunda addeza «Denda! Ne halaa ekkada neso ba» gides.
Gunda addezikka dendidi baso bides.
Dereykka hessa be7idi malaleteththaninne babon kumidi hayssa mala godateth asas immida Xoossaa galatides.
Yesusi Matoosa Xeygides
Yesusi heeppe dendidi bishe issi Matoosa geetettizaadey qaraxa qanxxisizason uttidayssa be7idi, «Tana kaalla!» giin dendidi iza kaallides.
Yesusi Matoosason maadda bolla dishin daro qaraxa qaraxizaytinne nagaranchchati izakko yiidi izaranne iza kaallizaytara issife maanaas uttida.
Farsaaweti hessa biyidi Yesusa kaallizayta, «Inttena tamaarsizayssi qaraxa qanxxisizaytaranne nagaranchchatara waani isttara issife kath mizee?» gi oychchida.
Yesusikka istti gizayssa siyidi isttas, «Aakimey koshshizay sakettidaytas attiin sakettontta paxatas gidenna.
Hessa gishshas, ‹Intte biidi yarsho gidontta maaroteth dosays› giza qaalaa birsheth tamaarte. Nagaranchchata xeygana yadis attiin xillota xeyganaas yabeekke» gides.
Yesusa Kaallizayti Xooma Xoomontta Gaaso
Xammaqiza Yohannisa kaallizayti Yesusaakko yiidi, «Nuninne Farsaaweti xoomishin nena kaallizayti aazas xoomettennee?» gi oychchida.
Yesusi isttas, «Mishiraa laggeti mishirazi isttara dishin muuzottana bessizee? Mishiray isttafe ekettana wodey yaana; istti he wode xoomana.
«Gal7a may7o bolla ooraththa woso woththi sikkiza asi deenna. Gal7a bolla oorath woththi sikkiko ooraththazi gal7aza peedhereththidi daaketh haa darssana.

Oonikka ooraththa woyne ushshu gal7a lukkamon gujjenna. Gujjizaa gidikko lukkamozi dhuuqqana; woyne cajjezikka gukkana; lukkamozikka go7ay bayndaaz gidana. Gido attiin ooraththa woyne cajjey ooraththa lukkamozan gujjeettes. Hessa malara woyne cajjezinne lukkamozi lo7on naagettidi gam7ees» gides.
Ya7iroosa Nayonne Yesusa Afala Macara Bochchida Maccassayo
Yesusi asaa haasaysson dishin issi shuumey iza sinththan kundidi, «Taas naa daara hayqqana gawus. Iza paxa daana mala yaada ne kushe izi bolla woththarkii?» giin,
Yesusi dendidi izara bides; Yesusa kaallizaytikka izara bida.
Tammanne nam7u layth kumeth izippe suuththi gukkiza issi maccassaya Yesusappe guyera yaada iza afala macara bochchadus.
Iza hessa ooththiday, «Iza afalaa macara ta bochchidaakko paxana» giza ammanoy izi wozinan diza gishshas bochchadus.
Yesusikka guye simmi xeellidi maccassayo, «Aykkoy baa, ta nayee! Nena ne ammanoy paththides» giin maccassaya heerakka paxaa gadus.
Yesusikka shuumeza soo mata gakkishin derey zayeranne dinkera waassishe yeekkizayssa be7idi,
«Kichchite! Naya dhiskadus attiin hayqqabeekku» giin istti iza bolla miiccida.
Derey wuri keeththafe keziin izi keeththaa gelidi nay kushe oykkides; nayakka denda eqqadus.
Iza goobateththi he dere ubbaan seetettides.
Yesusi Qooqetanne Doona Duudeza Paththides
Yesusikka heeppe bishin nam7u qooqeti, «Dawite Nawu! Nuna maararkkii!» giidi waassishe iza geedo kaallida.
Qooqetikka Yesusi gelida keeththaa iza kaallidi gelida. Yesusikka isttas, «Ta intte ayfe paththana dandayzayssa ammaneetii?» giidi oychchides. Isttika, «Ee, Godoo!» gida.
Hessafe guye Yesusi istta ayfe bochchidi, «Intte ammano mala inttes hano!» gides.
Istta ayfeykka xeellides. Yesusikka, «Hayssa oonikka erontta mala» giidi minththi yootides.
Gido attiin istti biidi heera ubbason Yesusa gishshas woresida.
Istti heeppe kezishin daydanththi oykkida issi doona duude as Yesusaakko ehida.
Daydanththazi kezidaappe guye he doona duude addezi haasaya oykkides; derezikka malalettidi, «Hayssa mala hanoy Isra7eele biittan haniin nu beyi erokko» gida.
Gido attiin Farsaaweti zaaridi iza, «Daydanth kessizay daydanththata halaqanna» gida.
Yesusi Deraas Mishettides
Yesusi Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan Ayhudata tamaarsishenne Xoossa Kawoteththa Mishiraachcho qaala yootishe qasseka harge ubbaafe asaa paththishe gutatan gutatan yuuyides.
Asay wuri heemmizaadey baynda dorsa mala keehi metotettidi xeellizay bayndaade gididayssa be7ida wode isttas daro mishettides.
Bana kaallizaytaska, «Maxa gakkida kaththay daro shin maxi shiishshizayti guuththata.
Hessa gishshas kaththaa Goday kaththaako oosanchchata yeddana mala woossite!» gides.
